notes.title: Update 1.7.0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, long time no see! Trent here!
As many of you in the Official Discord know, we are heads-down working on Wizzerd Quest 2 right now. But I wanted to take an opportunity to do one final, small feature update to the original game. Here's the catch though: I'm not gonna tell you what I've changed. I will only say this:

Something has been added to the game. Something ancient, something dark... Have a look around town.

Best of luck, and hope to see you in Evenfall Bay when Wizzerd Quest 2 launches on Steam and Itch.io later this year!
